messages:
Anna M: quick async — planning to roll the `feature_x_enable` flag tonight in the 10pm PT quiet window. plan: stagger waves (10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%) with smoke checks after each wave. safe default = OFF. who can own the push and smoke verification?

Ben K: I can push and monitor the first two waves. will be near my desk 9:45–11:30pm PT. what’s the exact cutover command?

Anna M: thanks Ben. cutover is via the flag-orch service. cmd: `./flag-orch set feature_x_enable --percentage 10 --env prod --note "wave1-staged"` then increment. ops-bot will annotate.

Carlos R: heads up — there’s a dependent config `cache_prefetch` that we should ensure is OFF for the first two waves. otherwise we might see evictions. Emily, is that already gated?

Emily S: confirmed — `cache_prefetch=false` is set in the prod-safe-config for this rollout window. I pushed a short-lived override to the canary tenant yesterday.

Ben K: perfect. smoke checklist I’ll run after each wave: 1) 200 OK rate on /v1/generate, 2) 95th latency within SLO on the canary shards, 3) no increase in error budget alerts, 4) quick sanity prompts against rollout promptset.

Anna M: add one more — verify KV cache hit ratio on the canary prefix doesn’t drop >10%. that caught regressions last time.

Ben K: good call. I’ll run a small script:```
# smoke-run snippet
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke ping"}' | jq .status
./metrics-check --prefix canary/feature_x --metric kv_hit --threshold 0.9
```

ops-bot: NOTE: scheduled quiet window lock from 2026-03-17T05:00:00Z to 2026-03-17T07:00:00Z. Automated rollback hook ready.

Anna M: rollback plan: immediate set to 0% + drain existing sessions: `./flag-orch set feature_x_enable --percentage 0 --note "rollback-{owner}"` then run `./drain-sessions --tag feature_x` and open incident if errors persist. owner should be the person who did the push.

Carlos R: if we see backend errors, also toggle `route_to_stable_model=true` in routing-config to avoid model variant fallthrough. that’s fast to flip.

Emily S: I’ll be on-call for post-rollout logs and tracing. if anything odd appears, ping #eng-oncall as well.

Ben K: owning push. timeline: start wave1 @ 02:00 UTC (10pm PT), wait 5m, smoke, then wave2 at +15m if good. will post updates in this thread.

Anna M: thank you. quick checklist before we close: - Ben owns push and smoke - Emily on logs/traces - Carlos DB/cache config watch - ops-bot has the window and rollback hooks. everyone okay? :thumbsup:

Carlos R: :thumbsup:

Emily S: :thumbsup:

Ben K: :thumbsup: see you on the thread at push time.

Anna M: leaving a final note — if performance dips but errors are stable, prefer 25% hold and extra 30m monitoring rather than full rollback. small degradation okay if user-facing correctness is preserved.

Ben K: got it. will escalate if error rates tick or kv hit drops >10%.

Anna M: closing for now. will reopen with timestamps and results after each wave. thanks all!
